Name: Bigger Backpack
Author: bcmpinc
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Buy a bigger backpack at Pierre's for only 50,000g! This backpack has 48 slots.

[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
[i]Note: run Stardew Valley once with this mod enabled to generate the[/i]
[code]config.json[/code][i]file.[/i]
[list]
[*][code]BackpackCost[/code]: How much you have to pay to buy this backpack in the shop. Default = 50000).[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Console Commands[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][code]player_setbackpacksize slots[/code]: Changes the size of your inventory. Valid values for slots are 12, 24, 36 and 48. Items in the removed slots will be spilled onto the ground.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Dependencies[/b][/size]
This mod requires the following mods to be installed:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3213]StardewHack[/url][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Known bugs[/b][/size]
Please report bugs on [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/BiggerBackpack/issues]GitHub[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845?tab=bugs]Nexus[/url].
[list]
[*]This mod does not support android / mobile.[/*]
[*]The 4th inventory row does not show up in the museum.[/*]
[*]There is only one upgrade. If you want more, take a look at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21588]The Return Of Custom Backpack Framework[/url].[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]
To remove the mod, first run
[code]player_setbackpacksize 36[/code]in the SMAPI console and safe your game.
